correctness.rationale: The exact normalized derivative-Legendre Vandermonde determinant product holds for the stated 16-by-16 matrix, with ring phases contributing only unimodular factors. In each height-ordering chamber log determinant has Hessian at most -4I, tends to -infinity at collision/pole boundaries, and has a unique interior maximizer. Strong concavity bounds the unknown optimum by each rational test value and squared rational gradient. CHECKER.py verifies all six rational gradient bounds, five adjacent comparisons and ratio interval. Those exact inequalities and the analytic curvature argument prove the claim over all real admissible heights. A separate direct complex harmonic evaluation agrees with the factorization and is not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 1+3+5+7 minimal harmonic sampling pattern is a natural first three-free-ring design. The objective is the determinant information volume of the full 16-mode acquisition matrix. A complete six-chamber global design classification, unique best physical ring order, and >4 factor gap are nontrivial and guide sensor placement. This is distinct from routine input substitution: the prior general product/concavity leaves global chamber comparison unsolved and five nonlinear inequalities plus exact witnesses are required.
